audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Leviticus / Vayiqra offering text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for call from tent, whole burnt offering/olah from herd, flock, or birds, hand-laying, blood/life, altar, and soothing scent.

verses.restored: YHWH called to Moses and spoke to him from tent of meeting, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD called to Moses and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,

original.text: וַיִּקְרָ֖א אֶל מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֵלָ֔יו מֵאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לֵאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Speak to children of Israel and say to them: When a human from you brings near an offering to YHWH, from beast, from herd or from flock, you shall bring near your offering.

familiar.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the LORD, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.

modern.text: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When any of you brings an offering to the LORD, you may bring as your offering an animal from the herd or the flock.

original.text: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אָדָ֗ם כִּֽי יַקְרִ֥יב מִכֶּ֛ם קָרְבָּ֖ן לַֽיהוָ֑ה מִן הַבְּהֵמָ֗ה מִן הַבָּקָר֙ וּמִן הַצֹּ֔אן תַּקְרִ֖יבוּ אֶת קָרְבַּנְכֶֽם

verses.restored: If his offering is burnt offering from herd, a complete male he shall bring near; to entrance of tent of meeting he shall bring it near for acceptance before YHWH.

familiar.text: If his offering be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD.

modern.text: If one’s offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he is to present an unblemished male. He must bring it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting for its acceptance before the LORD.

original.text: אִם עֹלָ֤ה קָרְבָּנוֹ֙ מִן הַבָּקָ֔ר זָכָ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים יַקְרִיבֶ֑נּוּ אֶל פֶּ֝תַח אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ יַקְרִ֣יב אֹת֔וֹ לִרְצֹנ֖וֹ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: He shall lay his hand upon head of burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement/covering for him.

familiar.text: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

modern.text: He is to lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, so it can be accepted on his behalf to make atonement for him.

original.text: וְסָמַ֣ךְ יָד֔וֹ עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הָעֹלָ֑ה וְנִרְצָ֥ה ל֖וֹ לְכַפֵּ֥ר עָלָֽיו

verses.restored: He shall slaughter son of cattle before YHWH; sons of Aaron, the priests, shall bring near blood/life and throw blood/life against altar all around, at entrance of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And he shall kill the bullock before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that is by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

modern.text: And he shall slaughter the young bull before the LORD, and Aaron’s sons the priests are to present the blood and sprinkle it on all sides of the altar at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: וְשָׁחַ֛ט אֶת בֶּ֥ן הַבָּקָ֖ר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ֠הִקְרִיבוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֤ן הַֽכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ אֶת הַדָּ֔ם וְזָרְק֨וּ אֶת הַדָּ֤ם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ סָבִ֔יב אֲשֶׁר פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: He shall skin burnt offering and cut it into its pieces.

familiar.text: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.

modern.text: Next, he is to skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.

original.text: וְהִפְשִׁ֖יט אֶת הָעֹלָ֑ה וְנִתַּ֥ח אֹתָ֖הּ לִנְתָחֶֽיהָ

verses.restored: Sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on altar and arrange wood upon fire.

familiar.text: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:

modern.text: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put a fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.

original.text: וְ֠נָתְנוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֧ן הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֵ֖שׁ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְעָרְכ֥וּ עֵצִ֖ים עַל הָאֵֽשׁ

verses.restored: Sons of Aaron, the priests, shall arrange pieces, head, and fat upon wood that is on fire upon altar.

familiar.text: And the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:

modern.text: Then Aaron’s sons the priests are to arrange the pieces, including the head and the fat, atop the burning wood on the altar.

original.text: וְעָרְכ֗וּ בְּנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים אֵ֚ת הַנְּתָחִ֔ים אֶת הָרֹ֖אשׁ וְאֶת הַפָּ֑דֶר עַל הָעֵצִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הָאֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ

verses.restored: Its inward parts and legs he shall wash with water, and priest shall turn all into smoke on altar; it is burnt offering, fire-offering, soothing scent to YHWH.

familiar.text: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

modern.text: The entrails and legs must be washed with water, and the priest shall burn all of it on the altar as a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

original.text: וְקִרְבּ֥וֹ וּכְרָעָ֖יו יִרְחַ֣ץ בַּמָּ֑יִם וְהִקְטִ֨יר הַכֹּהֵ֤ן אֶת הַכֹּל֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עֹלָ֛ה אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ נִיח֖וֹחַ לַֽיהוָֽה

verses.restored: If his offering is from flock, from sheep or goats, for burnt offering, complete male he shall bring near.

familiar.text: And if his offering be of the flocks, namely, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.

modern.text: If, however, one’s offering is a burnt offering from the flock—from the sheep or goats—he is to present an unblemished male.

original.text: וְאִם מִן הַצֹּ֨אן קָרְבָּנ֧וֹ מִן הַכְּשָׂבִ֛ים א֥וֹ מִן הָעִזִּ֖ים לְעֹלָ֑ה זָכָ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים יַקְרִיבֶֽנּוּ

verses.restored: He shall slaughter it on north side of altar before YHWH, and sons of Aaron, the priests, shall throw its blood/life against altar all around.

familiar.text: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.

modern.text: He shall slaughter it on the north side of the altar before the LORD, and Aaron’s sons the priests are to sprinkle its blood against the altar on all sides.

original.text: וְשָׁחַ֨ט אֹת֜וֹ עַ֣ל יֶ֧רֶךְ הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ צָפֹ֖נָה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְזָרְק֡וּ בְּנֵי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים אֶת דָּמ֛וֹ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב

verses.restored: He shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and fat, and priest shall arrange them on wood that is on fire upon altar.

familiar.text: And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:

modern.text: He is to cut the animal into pieces, and the priest shall arrange them, including the head and fat, atop the burning wood that is on the altar.

original.text: וְנִתַּ֤ח אֹתוֹ֙ לִנְתָחָ֔יו וְאֶת רֹאשׁ֖וֹ וְאֶת פִּדְר֑וֹ וְעָרַ֤ךְ הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֹתָ֔ם עַל הָֽעֵצִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הָאֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ

verses.restored: Inward parts and legs he shall wash with water, and priest shall bring near all and turn it into smoke on altar; it is burnt offering, fire-offering, soothing scent to YHWH.

familiar.text: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring it all, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

modern.text: The entrails and legs must be washed with water, and the priest shall bring all of it and burn it on the altar; it is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

original.text: וְהַקֶּ֥רֶב וְהַכְּרָעַ֖יִם יִרְחַ֣ץ בַּמָּ֑יִם וְהִקְרִ֨יב הַכֹּהֵ֤ן אֶת הַכֹּל֙ וְהִקְטִ֣יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עֹלָ֣ה ה֗וּא אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: If his offering to YHWH is burnt offering from birds, he shall bring near his offering from turtledoves or sons of pigeon.

familiar.text: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the LORD be of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.

modern.text: If, instead, one’s offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds, he is to present a turtledove or a young pigeon.

original.text: וְאִ֧ם מִן הָע֛וֹף עֹלָ֥ה קָרְבָּנ֖וֹ לַֽיהוָ֑ה וְהִקְרִ֣יב מִן הַתֹּרִ֗ים א֛וֹ מִן בְּנֵ֥י הַיּוֹנָ֖ה אֶת קָרְבָּנֽוֹ

verses.restored: The priest shall bring it near to altar, pinch off its head, turn it into smoke on altar, and its blood/life shall be drained on side of altar.

familiar.text: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:

modern.text: Then the priest shall bring it to the altar, twist off its head, and burn it on the altar; its blood should be drained out on the side of the altar.

original.text: וְהִקְרִיב֤וֹ הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וּמָלַק֙ אֶת רֹאשׁ֔וֹ וְהִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה וְנִמְצָ֣ה דָמ֔וֹ עַ֖ל קִ֥יר הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ

verses.restored: He shall remove its crop with its feathers/waste and throw it beside altar eastward, to place of ashes.

familiar.text: And he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:

modern.text: And he is to remove the crop with its contents and throw it to the east side of the altar, in the place for ashes.

original.text: וְהֵסִ֥יר אֶת מֻרְאָת֖וֹ בְּנֹצָתָ֑הּ וְהִשְׁלִ֨יךְ אֹתָ֜הּ אֵ֤צֶל הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ קֵ֔דְמָה אֶל מְק֖וֹם הַדָּֽשֶׁן

verses.restored: He shall tear it open by its wings, not divide it completely; priest shall turn it into smoke on altar, on wood that is on fire; it is burnt offering, fire-offering, soothing scent to YHWH.

familiar.text: And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof, but shall not divide it asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

modern.text: He shall tear it open by its wings, without dividing the bird completely. And the priest is to burn it on the altar atop the burning wood. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

original.text: וְשִׁסַּ֨ע אֹת֣וֹ בִכְנָפָיו֮ לֹ֣א יַבְדִּיל֒ וְהִקְטִ֨יר אֹת֤וֹ הַכֹּהֵן֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עַל הָעֵצִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הָאֵ֑שׁ עֹלָ֣ה ה֗וּא אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה

translation_notes: Hebrew Vayiqra opens with calling from the completed tent: Leviticus continues Exodus presence.
Korban/offering means something brought near; sacrificial grammar is about approach/nearness, not crude appeasement.
Olah/burnt offering rises wholly in smoke; preserve as whole-offering/ascending offering in later audit.
Blood/life language should be kept as ritual life-symbolism, not gore spectacle.
Bird option preserves access for poorer worshipers.
safety_note: Do not read Leviticus 1 as Divine hunger for violence. It is ancient ritual grammar for approach, surrender, and life-symbolism around the altar, with scaled access for different means.
